LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.Settings.TutorialLettersDesc: Send a one-time explanatory letter when a mechanic is first encountered.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.Tutorial.grant_hint.Label: Grant Pharna
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.Tutorial.grant_hint.Text: You can now perform the "Grant Pharna" ritual. Let a colonist become a member of your familia!\n\nPlace a ritual spot, then select "Grant Pharna" from the ritual list and choose a colonist as the recipient.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.Tutorial.grant_hint_nomeme.T:
Your culture has not chosen the "Familia Myth" structure, so you may not be able to experience most of this mod's content.
If you want to play this mod's Pharna system, choose the culture structure named "Familia Myth" when creating your culture.

Or... is it time to use your divine power (DevMode)?
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.Tutorial.intro_grant.Label: Pharna granted
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.Tutorial.intro_grant.Text:
{0} has been granted Pharna and has become the first member of your familia.
Here are a few things you may want to know:

Stats:
The six stats grow through daily activity:
combat and training raise Strength,
taking damage and gaining nutrition raise Endurance,
precise work raises Dexterity,
running and dodging raise Agility,
generating psychic entropy by casting spells raises Mana,
and meditation and social interaction raise Will.
The six values can be viewed in the Pharna tab.

Feats:
Feats come from combat resolution. Damage dealt, damage taken and support are all counted, and they are required for ascension.

You also have one inscription available:
choose a stat in the top bar of the Pharna tab, and experience gained afterwards will partly convert into that stat.
After each ascension you can inscribe again into a different stat.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.Tutorial.bottleneck.Label: Bottleneck
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.Tutorial.bottleneck.Text:
Stat growth has a bottleneck:
above 400 a single stat grows more and more slowly, and once the six stats total more than 2000 it decays further. The cap for a single stat is 999.

Ascension resets current values to zero and adds them to potential, and potential provides bonuses just like current values.

The exact decay factors can be viewed in the Pharna tab. Pace your training as you see fit.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.Tutorial.ascendable.Label: Pharna ascension
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.Tutorial.ascendable.Text:
{0} has a stat at Tier D plus feats of the matching tier, and already meets the requirements for ascension!

Open the Culture tab, select "Ascend Pharna" from the ritual list, and choose {0} as the recipient.

Ascension resets all six stats to zero and adds them to potential, and restores one inscription opportunity,
along with a choice of one out of three ascension rewards (skills, spells or developable abilities).

The Pharna level cap is 10. Ascension is no longer possible at the cap.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.Tutorial.first_spell.Label: Spells
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.Tutorial.first_spell.Text:
{0} is the first member of your familia to gain a spell!

Casting a spell requires an incantation of varying length. Mana is consumed during it and psychic entropy is generated. If mana is insufficient or psychic entropy exceeds the threshold (if one is set), the incantation is interrupted.

Mana must be converted by the caster from psyfocus, and the conversion itself also generates psychic entropy.
You can view the current mana in the mana pool below, and toggle "automatically convert psyfocus into mana" at its upper right corner.

Spell effects are also affected by the caster's Mana Control depending on spell type. The corresponding values can be viewed in the character's detail panel.
LanguageData.FamiliaMyth.Tutorial.first_devability.Te:
{0} is the first member of your familia to gain a developable ability!

Developable abilities accumulate proficiency through behavior just like basic stats, and their effects grow stronger with rarity.

Proficiency and the current tier can be viewed in the developable ability section of the Pharna tab.
